Midterms and BOE Rate Hikes Threatens Andy Burnham's Breathing Space. The newsletter says midterms and rate hikes threaten the "breathing space" the government tried to create just one week after the Budget. An exclusive Bloomberg survey of 35 economists predicts the first hike in over three years; all respondents expect the rate to be raised to 4% from 3.75%. The "breathing space" refers to the £4.1 billion of cost-of-living relief that Chancellor John Healey's budget provided households against rising inflation and energy costs.
